appDescription.message: Verifiable capture and preservation of digital evidence.

homeTitle.message: What would you like to do?

verifyPackageBody.message: Select a ZIP to calculate its SHA-256 locally without uploading the file.

fullVerificationNotice.message: Complete signature, chain, and receipt validation is performed by the offline verifier included in the project.

settingsBody.message: The language follows Chrome. Endpoints and retention are defined by the deployed environment.

loginBody.message: Enter your email. We will send a single-use link; no code or token is included in capture logs.

accessLinkSent.message: Check your email, open the link, and return here. This screen will detect access automatically.

newCaptureBody.message: Collects tab video, screenshots, DOM, visible text, and browser-reported metadata. Iframes are best effort, canvas/WebGL cover visible pixels only, and DRM content is unavailable. It does not prove authorship or truthfulness.

sensitiveDataNotice.message: Do not use for children's data, health or financial data, or trade secrets. Browse with context and respect third-party rights.

captureConsent.message: I understand the data collected, limitations, and risks.

discardCaptureConfirmation.message: Discard this capture's local buffer? The partial record already sent to the server will be preserved. This action cannot be undone.

partialCapture.message: This capture is partial. The package will record each unavailable item and its reason.

captureComplete.message: Capture complete. The package was sent to your downloads folder.

legalDisclaimer.message: Technical integrity does not guarantee definitive legal validity.
